mathematical_definition: causal_rolling_mean(0.5*log(h/l)^2 - (2*ln2 - 1)*log(c/o)^2, window=240) -- Garman-Klass per-bar variance proxy (NOT sqrt'd despite the '_vol' name: features.volatility.garman_klass returns the rolling-averaged variance quantity directly), rolling-averaged over a trailing 240-bar window
numerical_stability_notes: Non-finite per-bar values (e.g. from zero/negative range) are set to NaN before the rolling mean, assumes ~zero intrabar drift
missing_value_policy: NaN for windows with fewer than 240 observed bars, never zero-filled
